create_mc_dropout_agent: create an mc dropout agent using McDropoutConfig with configurable dropout rate, hidden sizes, and learning rate
configure_mc_dropout: configure mc dropout agent settings including dropout rate, length scale, regularization tau, and batch strategy
build_loss_function: build a combined cross-entropy and accuracy loss with l2 weight decay for mc dropout training
test_batch_strategy: test the batch strategy that scales training steps based on data ratio relative to input dimension
review_mc_dropout_config: review the McDropoutConfig dataclass with dropout rate, hidden sizes, learning rate, and seed parameters
